    Gabriel's covering theorem, graded form #

    Let A be a finite-dimensional algebra graded by a torsion-free group, such that every graded-indecomposable projective has a graded maximal submodule. If the graded-indecomposable modules are, up to isomorphism of A-modules, among finitely many Y₁, …, Y_r, then every indecomposable A-module is isomorphic to some Yⱼ (gabriel_density; Gabriel 1981, 3.6, in the language of graded modules).
